findingDetails.title: appendLog read-modify-write drops concurrent log lines
findingDetails.scopeProof: Core scope only; appendLog is the sole writer of relaunch.log.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A single-writer guarantee for relaunch.log is documented and enforced.

findingDetails.title: Gate-3 Skip suffix has an unbalanced parenthesis, duplicated across contract, printers, README and tests
findingDetails.scopeProof: Two string literals plus their docs/tests; no control flow.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None; cosmetic only. Fix requires a contract amendment plus both printers.

findingDetails.title: Killer aborts on an unreadable transcript instead of failing open
findingDetails.scopeProof: Only the transcript polling path inside the core killer.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Runtime transcript immutability during a live session is documented as a guarantee.

spec_code.details: Four core files checked against interface-contract sections 4, 7, 9 and 11.5-11.11; three deviations recorded as P2; contract self-inconsistency on consume/cd order noted for D3.

noveltyJustification: First iteration against an empty registry; all three P2 findings are new.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Four-file core inventory plus tests and binding contract sections.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Dispatch Next Focus names the core inventory and its tests.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The record lifecycle could relaunch from a disarmed or pending record or skip the armed check.

searchActions.result: arm/unarm/shouldRelaunch guards and the killer re-read before SIGTERM match the contract.

searchLedger.rationale: All transitions and guards match contract section 4 and their unit tests.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Verified by direct read of relaunch-core.cjs, killer.cjs and the transition tests.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Two processes can write relaunch.log at the same time and lose an event line.
searchLedger.invariant: Every appendLog call leaves exactly one additional line in the log.

searchActions.result: appendLog reads the whole file and renames a temp file over it; the killer is a detached concurrent writer.

searchLedger.rationale: Overlapping read-modify-write cycles drop one line; contract promises a plain append.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The Gate-3 Skip suffix text is malformed in one or both printers.

searchActions.result: The same unbalanced-parenthesis literal appears in core, wrapper, README, tests and the contract.

searchLedger.rationale: Cosmetic but user-facing and copied into the receiving prompt; contract mandates the same typo.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A transcript stat error can abort the killer before it signals the target.

searchActions.result: transcriptMtime calls statSync with no error handling; the throw reaches main().catch and exits 1.

searchLedger.rationale: Fail-open posture is documented for sibling transcript reads but not implemented here.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Relaunch drops operator flags that are required to start the runtime.

searchActions.result: Only model/provider/extensions/name plus the seed are rebuilt, matching contract 11.6-11.7 and the wrapper tests.

searchLedger.rationale: Documented intended behavior, not a defect.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Contract 11.6-11.7 and wrapper test "second invocation uses only the seed and name" define the carry set.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Two killers observing a stale lock can both run and double-signal the target.

searchActions.result: Stale-lock unlink and recreate is not atomic; the window is small and the armed-record check bounds the effect.

searchLedger.rationale: Process-safety depth belongs to the security iteration; carry the TOCTOU analysis forward.
searchLedger.deferredReason: Deferred to D2 security with the EPERM edge case.
